title: Mars Surface Field Investigation
subtitle: Ground-Level Geological Observation, Soil Sampling and Laboratory Analysis
description: Continue investigating the exact target selected in Sol 3 and studied in Sols 4 and 5. Travel on foot to the target, record ground-level geological observations, collect and secure one soil/regolith sample, return through the existing Airlock, analyse the sample in the Science Lab and start a cultivation experiment whose result remains pending until Sol 8.

persistentMissionData.selectionRule: Resolve only the target selected and submitted in Sol 3 through the existing target registry. Do not allow a new target selection in Sol 6.
requiredPriorEvidence: PHOBOSIA_SOL_05 target-linked aerial evidence and report

tasks.title: Review Surface Investigation Briefing
tasks.objective: Review briefing, persistent target, Sol 4 records, Sol 5 aerial evidence, route considerations and required equipment.

tasks.title: Prepare Geological Field Equipment
tasks.objective: Prepare available sample container, ID/sealing workflow, collection tool and contamination-control documentation.

tasks.title: Prepare for Mars Surface Exploration
tasks.objective: Activate the existing global EVA suit system through its existing Airlock interaction.

tasks.title: Reach the Selected Investigation Target
tasks.objective: Travel manually on foot to the exact Sol 3 selected target using visual guidance; no teleport or autopilot.

tasks.title: Conduct Ground-Level Geological Observations
tasks.objective: Record target-linked ground-level observations and distinguish visible observations from player interpretation.

tasks.title: Collect and Secure a Soil Sample
tasks.objective: Collect one soil/regolith sample, assign a unique ID, record provenance and secure it.

tasks.title: Return to the Airlock
tasks.objective: Return manually through the existing Airlock entrance while preserving the active suit and sample.

tasks.title: Complete Airlock Entry and Remove EVA Suit
tasks.objective: Remove the suit inside the Airlock through the existing interaction; never auto-remove it at Central Hub.

tasks.title: Transfer Sample to the Science Lab
tasks.objective: Register receipt of the same sample ID and preserve its provenance.

tasks.title: Perform Preliminary Sample Analysis
tasks.objective: Record supported visual observations/readings, limitations and player interpretation.

tasks.title: Initiate Soil Cultivation Experiment
tasks.objective: Load/register the same sample in the existing cultivation unit and start an experiment persisted as IN_PROGRESS until Sol 8.

tasks.title: Submit Sol 6 Surface Investigation Report
tasks.objective: Submit verified field observations, sample provenance, preliminary analysis and pending cultivation status.

objectives.title: Review Surface Investigation Mission
objectives.description: Review the Sol 6 briefing, official Sol 3 target, relevant Sol 4 and Sol 5 records, route considerations and equipment at the existing Mission Control console.
objectives.completionCondition: Briefing is confirmed and the exact persistent target resolves through the existing registry.

objectives.title: Prepare Field Equipment
objectives.description: Review and prepare the available sample container, identification label, sealing method, collection tool and contamination-control documentation in the existing Science Lab.
objectives.completionCondition: Available required equipment is reviewed and marked ready; do not require nonexistent equipment.

objectives.title: Prepare for Surface Exploration
objectives.description: Activate the global EVA suit using the existing Mars_Observation_Preparation_Trigger in the Airlock before entering Mars terrain.
objectives.completionCondition: Existing EVA system confirms an active suit session and allows physical Mars terrain entry.

objectives.title: Reach the Selected Investigation Target
objectives.description: Enter Mars terrain and walk to the exact Sol 3 selected target. Reuse the Sol 5 red/red-orange target beacon, resolved from the actual target world transform.
objectives.completionCondition: Player physically reaches the validated ground-investigation area of the same selected target; navigation arrival alone is insufficient.

objectives.title: Conduct Geological Field Observations
objectives.description: Record regolith appearance/texture, visible rock distribution, slope/elevation, formations and local terrain features. Compare with Sol 5 aerial evidence where useful.
objectives.completionCondition: At least one valid target-linked observation record is persisted; separate observation from interpretation.

objectives.title: Collect and Secure Soil Sample
objectives.description: Collect one soil/regolith sample using the supported field interaction and existing container. Record unique sample ID, target, location, Sol, sample type and container/sealing status.
objectives.completionCondition: One uniquely identified sample is persisted as COLLECTED_AND_SECURED with required provenance; no drilling, mining or extra samples.

objectives.title: Return to the Airlock
objectives.description: Carry the secured sample and manually return through the existing Airlock entrance. Keep the EVA suit active during transition and spawn at the configured Airlock spawn.
objectives.completionCondition: Existing transition places player in Airlock and preserves sample and active EVA session.

objectives.title: Remove EVA Suit Inside the Airlock
objectives.description: Use the existing EVA preparation/removal interaction inside Airlock. Central Hub entrance remains blocked until suit is inactive.
objectives.completionCondition: Global EVA confirms suit inactive, helmet/HUD disabled and existing Central Hub entrance becomes accessible.

objectives.title: Transfer Sample to the Science Lab
objectives.description: Register the secured sample at the existing Science Lab sample-handling area without changing its ID or provenance.
objectives.completionCondition: Science Lab acknowledges receipt of the same sample ID without creating a duplicate.

objectives.title: Perform Preliminary Sample Analysis
objectives.description: Use existing analysis equipment to record visible appearance, grain size/texture, colour and genuinely supported indicators. Label simulated gameplay readings as simulated.
objectives.completionCondition: Analysis record linked to the same sample ID is saved. Do not claim water, organics, microorganisms or life without supporting data.

objectives.title: Initiate Soil Cultivation Experiment
objectives.description: Load/register the analysed sample in the existing cultivation unit and start the experiment. It takes approximately two in-game Sols; result is not available in Sol 6.
objectives.completionCondition: Existing unit confirms a persisted experiment linked to the sample ID, status IN_PROGRESS, expected result Sol 8. Do not reveal a final result in Sol 6.

objectives.title: Submit Surface Investigation Report
objectives.description: Submit the report at the existing Mission Control reporting interface with target, field observations, sample provenance, preliminary analysis and cultivation marked pending until Sol 8.
objectives.completionCondition: Report passes validation and references persisted sample/analysis records and pending experiment status.

objectives.title: Complete Sol 6
objectives.description: Complete Sol 6 after all mandatory objectives and report submission have been validated.
objectives.completionCondition: All mandatory objectives and report are complete; cultivation experiment is persisted for future Sol 8 retrieval.
